name: squeeze-in
title: Squeeze In
description: Characters are uncovered one by one by a clean wipe, then the whole word squeezes tighter as the last one lands.
useWhen: A wordmark or short title should be uncovered by a clean wipe, as if a cover slid off it.
The arrival of the last character should compress every letter gap, so the word settles tighter.
avoidWhen: The word should collapse from a wide tracked-out state with blur: use tracking-in.
Characters should rise or drop into place: use per-character-rise or top-down-letters.
author: Studio

variables.label: Stagger
variables.description: Frames per character while the wipe uncovers it (30 fps).

variables.label: Squeeze
variables.description: How wide the letter gaps start, as a fraction of the font size. They close to zero.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Maximum text size in pixels. Longer text shrinks to fit the frame.
